description: Describe the report data catalog: every source an Insights report may read, with its measures, group-bys, filter fields and the widget types that render it. Read it before you build a query. Where it says preview_query, use anyforge_preview_report_query; where it says list_filter_values, use anyforge_list_report_filter_values. Requires `read` scope and a role that edits reports.
name: anyforge_describe_report_catalog
title: Describe report catalog
